name: Whopperflower Nectar
description:
Nectar extracted from the stamen of a Whopperflower that contains trace amounts of elemental energy.
The taste of the nectar has a hint of Sweet Flower in it.
fullDescription: Nectar extracted from the stamen of a Whopperflower that contains trace amounts of elemental energy. The taste of the nectar has a hint of Sweet Flower in it.
